# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for this repository. Do not open a public issue containing vulnerability details, suspected secrets, or personal data.

Private vulnerability reporting will be enabled after the public repository exists. Until then, publication remains blocked and this staged source is not an external reporting channel.

## Scope

This repository is a synthetic, static public showcase. Reports should concern the code and files in this repository. The private operational system, production infrastructure, retailer services, and third-party accounts are out of scope.
